title: The Grunion Run, xxi
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Twenty-first year. A tourist films the run on a phone. The strip draws the phone's screen showing the run and the run at the same time. One is smaller.

panels.composition: The beach, the run, lanterns. A TOURIST holding a phone up between the reader and the surf. On the screen: the surf. Behind the screen: the surf. WOOD and BARNABY II at the edge.

image.prompt: a night beach festival where a tourist holds a phone up so its screen shows the same surf line of silver fish that is visible behind it, a thin man and a three-legged dog at the edge, clean ink with a muted wash
image.notes: The screen's surf is smaller and brighter than the real one. Draw both.

panels.composition: The screen. The fish, tiny, bright.

image.prompt: close-up of a phone screen showing tiny bright silver fish at a surf line

panels.composition: The real surf. The fish, life-size, dark silver in lantern light.

image.prompt: close-up of a real surf line at night with life-size silver fish in lantern light

panels.composition: Silent. The tourist gone. The surf. The pup in it. Wood, pad closed, looking at the real one.

image.prompt: silent wide night beach panel with silver fish and lanterns, a three-legged dog in the surf, a man with a closed pad looking at the water, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust
